exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.5: A dragon without fire is just a lizard with ambitions.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.6: Pixies don't lie. We just forget to tell some parts.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.7: A thousand years, and people still punch trees.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.8: Hidden chests don't hide themselves. Someone didn't want you to find them.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.9: If you see sheep without a shepherd, look closely: maybe he has only one eye.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.10: A treasure without an owner is a treasure waiting for one.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.11: I knew many heroes. Almost all were buried with their swords.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.12: A house breaks with one blow. A friendship, not so much. Lucky for you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.13: I know many things. Some I might even tell you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.14: A pixie without an owner is a lantern without light.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.idle.15: A sword without an edge is a stick with pride.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cake.offe: My friends won't see us empty-handed... I know some witches near here. They have cakes. Lots of cakes.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cake.star: Follow me! On the way I'll tell you about witches.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cake.desc: She takes you to some witches' cottage: their chest is full of cakes. Take one for her friends.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cake.goal: Take a cake from the witches' chest
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cake.done: A cake! My friends will love you. Well... they'll love the cake.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cake.pass: You already have pixie friends. No cake needed!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.friends.o: Will you take me to see my friends? Bring the cake.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.friends.s: Let me remember where they live...
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.friends.d: Take a cake to the great tree's sanctuary or to the pixies' mossy cave. Drop it (Q) near a pixie: she'll be yours.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.friends.g: Drop the cake near a pixie
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.friends.d: Now you have a real pixie friend! Bond with her: %s.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.friends.p: You already have a pixie of your own. My friends will understand.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.graveyard: I know of an old graveyard. Ruins from another age... want to see them?
Let me remember where it was...
Visit an ancient graveyard. Ghosts walk there at night.
Reach her lantern at the graveyard
Here they rest. I knew some of them... none as brave as you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.bones.off: I know where a dragon died long ago. Its bones make the best weapons. Shall we go?
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.bones.sta: I remember it well. Follow me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.bones.des: Find a dragon skeleton and take 4 bones from it (right-click it with an empty hand).
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.bones.her: There it is. Right-click it with an empty hand to take its bones.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.bones.don: Two bones and a wither bone make a sword. Wither skeletons live in the Nether.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.bones.pas: You already carry better weapons than dragon bones make. Never mind them.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cyclops.o: A cyclops grazes his sheep not far from here. His eye is worth a lot... Dare you?
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cyclops.s: Follow me. And don't stand in front of him.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cyclops.d: Find a cyclops. Hurt one of his sheep and he'll come; beat him and take his eye.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cyclops.h: That's his flock. Hurt a sheep and he'll come. The eye is yours if you win.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cyclops.d: The cyclops' eye! Keep it: it sees what others can't.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.mausoleum: There are ruins older than the graves: a mausoleum. Something dark sleeps there.
Visit a mausoleum, the deepest of the ancient ruins.
Reach her lantern at the mausoleum
An old dread lord lies here. Some names are better left unsaid.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.egg.offer: Grown dragons breed in caves: the mother keeps her eggs, her mate keeps her. One egg could be yours...
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.egg.start: I know a den with a mother. Quietly now.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.egg.desc: Get a dragon egg from a dragons' den: a grown female (stage 4 or 5) keeps her eggs there, her mate near her. Only grown females lay eggs.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.egg.here: Shh... That's the mother, her eggs beside her. Her mate won't be far.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.egg.done: A dragon egg! Hatch it in fire, ice or lightning, as its color says.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.egg.passe: You already have a dragon of your own. You don't need another egg.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.temple.of: There's a temple where a gorgon lives. Want to see it? Without looking at her, of course.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.temple.st: Follow me. And don't look her in the eye.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.temple.de: Visit the gorgon's temple. Whoever meets her gaze turns to stone.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.temple.go: Reach her lantern at the temple
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.temple.do: Look at the statues... they were adventurers too. Don't look at her!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cryona.de: Not yet. When all my memories are back and you find her, I'll lend you my strength.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.later: Whenever you like. I'll ask you later.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.dropped: I've lived a thousand years; I'm in no hurry. Another day, then.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.already: You already have it! You saved me a quest.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.none: I don't feel one near. Let's explore, and I'll tell you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.other_wor: That isn't in this world. Let's go back to the surface.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.gone: Someone got here first. I know of another place.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.subtitle: Exiled pixie
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.lore: A pixie over a thousand years old. Her knowledge is vast; her intentions of using it, not so much.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.bond: Her bond grows with her quests and the foes you beat near her (%s more to the next level). Each level, more of the pixies' gifts.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.adopt: She goes with you from now on: your guide, with her quests and her gifts.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.talk: She tells you about your quest or her thousand years.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.summon: She comes out with you: her gifts, her guidance, her remarks.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.rest: She rests: no gifts, no guidance, no remarks.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.talk_mo: How often she talks on her own.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.guide: She flies ahead of you toward the quest's place.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.pick: Pick a quest from the list.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.accept: She takes you there and lights her lantern at the place: reach it.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.accept_: She leaves the quest under way for this one.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.later: She'll offer it again in a while.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.drop: You leave it for another day: her mark goes. You can take it up again.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.gifts.title: With her near: %s%% of the gifts of all pixies together
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.gifts.grow: At full bond: half of them all (50%%).
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.gifts.full: Full bond: half the gifts of all pixies.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.tip.stat: From the %s pixie: %s%% of her gift at its best.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.ability.des: She recalls chests never opened within %s blocks: a light over each, and she flies to the nearest.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.hint: Point at something to know more.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.checkpoint.made: I lit my lantern there. Go to the light!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.vision.call: Wait! It's her... Come with me, now.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.vision.0: This is my oldest memory: the glade where I was born, over a thousand years ago.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.vision.1: I think it's the right moment.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.vision.2: That queen, Cryona... she is the girl marked by ice. When I could help her, I didn't.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.vision.3: I won't make the same mistake twice. I'll give you the most precious thing I kept from my past life.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.vision.gift: Resistance to absolute ice. Her cold won't catch you so easily anymore.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.vision.gift_nam: Pixie's gift: Resistance to Absolute Ice
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.vision.back: Now. Let's go: you don't go without me.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.gift_ice.de: Her last gift: Black Frost's breath first only chills you, and its ice holds you half as long; you recover faster. Absolute Zero takes half your life, not nine tenths.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.0: A villager once traded me one emerald for three. I never knew who won.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.1: Villagers say 'hmm' to everything. I've spent a thousand years trying to decode it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.2: I knew a librarian who sold the same book to everyone. Very wise. Or very lazy.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.3: A farmer asked me to scare off the crows. There were no crows. I scared the farmer.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.4: Villagers ring the bell when there's danger... and then just stare at it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.5: A smith made me a tiny sword. I still don't know what to cut with it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.6: There was a village where everyone fished. It smelled of fish up to the moon.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.7: A jobless villager followed me for three days. I think he wanted to be a pixie.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.8: Clerics sell ender pearls. I never asked where they get them.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.9: I once slept in a farmer's hat. He didn't notice for a week.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.1: Villagers lock themselves in at night. They're smarter than they look.
A cartographer sold me a map of my own house. Very useful, now that it's gone.
I knew a villager who talked to his golem. It never answered. Great friends.
Village kids never stop running. I once tried to keep up. Bad idea.
A butcher wanted to trade me for meat. I explained pixies aren't food.
Some villagers change jobs if you break their lectern. Like some kings.
I saw two villagers argue over a bed. Whoever lay down first won.
The shepherd dyes his sheep. I suggested lilac. He loved it.
Villagers plant, harvest and plant again. A thousand years the same. Admirable.
A fletcher asked me for feathers. I said I'd give him a wing. He believed me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.2: When a villager gets angry, he raises his prices. That's how they hold grudges.
Save a villager from a zombie and he gives you a discount. It's something.
There was a desert village that built everything from sand. Even the jokes.
Snow villagers dress in white. Once they mistook me for a snowflake.
A librarian read me a whole book. It was recipes. I stayed hungry.
Villagers never build walls. They have faith. Or laziness.
I once hid a village's bell. It took them a year to notice.
Masons sell bricks. I never saw them build anything with them.
A villager gave me a carrot. I think it was the best day of his life.
Iron golems give poppies to children. The sweetest thing I've ever seen.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.3: If lightning hits a villager, they become a witch. That's why they dislike rain.
A whole village called me 'the chatty firefly'. I never went back.
Villagers bump into each other and apologize. Well, they say 'hmm'.
I knew a cartographer who couldn't read maps. He sold them anyway.
A leatherworker made me a leaf-sized coat. Very elegant.
Villagers share bread when they have extra. Pixies share gossip.
Centuries ago they left milk at the window for me. Not anymore.
A weaponsmith swore his sword was the best. It broke that afternoon.
Zombies knock on village doors. Villagers never open. Good for them.
I once cured a zombie villager with a golden apple. He owes me one.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.villager.4: They sleep at dusk and rise with the sun. I envy their peace.
There was a villager selling sticks for gold. And people bought them.
Clerics know potions but never share them. Like witches.
A village kid chased me with a jar. Today he's a kind man. No jar.
Savanna houses have straw roofs. They smell like summer.
A village threw me a party. It was for the harvest, but I took it personally.
Hit a villager and the golem chases you. I learned that centuries ago.
Villagers never ask where you come from. Only how much you pay.
A librarian lent me a spell book. I still haven't returned it. Shh.
Villages grow on their own if you look after them. Like friendships.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.0: Witches love cakes. Sharing them, not so much.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.1: A witch never invites you to tea. She invites you to be the tea.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.2: Witches bake cakes just to hide them. Odd, isn't it?
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.3: I know some witches around here. Well, I know their chest.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.4: Why do witches cackle like that? Nobody returns their trays.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.5: Witches have black cats. Cats have witches. Nobody knows who's in charge.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.6: A witch gave me a potion 'to cheer me up'. I was green for a week.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.7: If a witch smiles at you, count your fingers afterwards.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.8: Witches don't sweep with brooms. They use them to scare off visitors.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.9: Their cauldron always boils. I never knew what they cook. Better that way.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.10: Witches have birthdays but never say how many. Neither do I.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.11: I asked a witch for her cake recipe. She threw a potion at me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.12: Witches don't have friends. They have accomplices.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.13: They say witches fly. I fly and nobody writes songs about me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.14: A lone cake in a cottage is no accident: it's a witch showing off.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.15: They keep cakes for special occasions. None ever comes.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.16: A witch called me a 'pretentious firefly'. I hid her hat.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.17: Witches never say 'thank you'. They say 'heh, heh, heh'.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.18: Why so many cakes if they never invite anyone? Mysteries of the cauldron.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.19: They drink potions like tea. I prefer nectar.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.20: Careful with witches in the rain: it's their favorite weather.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.21: A witch and a pixie can't be friends. But they can be neighbors who spy.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.22: Take a cake from a witch and she'll never notice. She has two hundred.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.23: Witches don't age. They wrinkle with style.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.24: A witch's hat is pointy so pixies can't land on it. It works.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.25: They cook with bats. The cakes, luckily, not.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.26: A witch invited me in. It was the cellar door. I didn't go.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.27: They say witches count their cakes every morning. A lie: they can't count.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.28: If a witch chases you, run in zigzags. Her potions fly straight.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.witch.29: Witches and I have something in common: a thousand years of bad decisions.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zombie.0: A zombie. Smells worse than my house after you chopped it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zombie.1: Zombies don't eat pixies. Too little meat.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zombie.2: That zombie was a villager once. How sad. And how slow.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zombie.3: If it burns in the sun, don't follow it into the shade.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zombie.4: A thousand years of zombies, and they still can't open iron doors.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zombie.5: It grunts like my aunt. She was a pixie, but she grunted the same.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.skeleton.0: A skeleton with a bow. Aim is the one thing it isn't missing.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.skeleton.1: Its bones make good fertilizer. Don't tell it I said so.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.skeleton.2: Behind a tree, a skeleton can't see you. I learned that the hard way.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.skeleton.3: Skeletons fear wolves. We all have a fear.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.skeleton.4: A pile of bones with a bad attitude. Like some kings I knew.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.skeleton.5: When you die, don't turn into that. Promise me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.creeper.0: A creeper! Don't hug it. It does want to hug you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.creeper.1: That hiss... Run! I'll explain later.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.creeper.2: Creepers fear cats. So do pixies, for other reasons.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.creeper.3: Green, silent and explosive. Like my cousin when she's angry.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.creeper.4: If lightning hits it, it gets worse. Like everything in life.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.creeper.5: A creeper has no arms. Or manners.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.spider.0: A spider. By day it's friendly. By night, not.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.spider.1: Spiders climb walls. I fly. A tie.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.spider.2: Their webs catch pixies. Keep me away, please.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.spider.3: Eight eyes and it can't see a sword coming. What a waste.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.spider.4: Its string makes bows. Taking it is poetic justice.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.spider.5: Spiders have given me the creeps since the fourth century.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.enderman.0: An enderman. Don't look it in the eye. I mean it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.enderman.1: They carry blocks home. I never knew why. Decorating, maybe.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.enderman.2: They hate water. So do I, when it wets my wings.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.enderman.3: If it gets angry, it appears behind you. Very rude.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.enderman.4: Tall, quiet and mysterious. My type, eight hundred years ago.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.enderman.5: With a pumpkin on your head it can't see you. Fashion and safety.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cow.0: A cow. Milk, leather and zero conversation.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cow.1: Cows don't run. They have all the time in the world. Like me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cow.2: I once slept on a cow. The longest nap of the century.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cow.3: Moo. That means 'stop staring' in cow.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cow.4: With a bucket she gives milk. With wheat she follows. Easy to convince.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cow.5: Milk clears potion effects. Witches hate cows.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sheep.0: A sheep. Soft wool, empty head.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sheep.1: Dye a sheep pink and her lambs will be too. Farm magic.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sheep.2: They eat grass and grow wool. Wish my wings worked that way.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sheep.3: Shear her, don't hurt her. Some cyclopes get angry for less.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sheep.4: Counting sheep to sleep works. I tried with a thousand.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sheep.5: A blue sheep. Either someone dyed her or she's very sad.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pig.0: A pig. With a saddle and a carrot on a stick, it's a luxury steed.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pig.1: If lightning hits it, it becomes a zombified piglin. Poor pig.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pig.2: Pigs find truffles. This one only finds mud.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pig.3: Oink. I never learned pig, but I know that's an insult.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pig.4: Pink, round and happy. There are worse lives.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pig.5: Don't name it if you plan to eat it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.chicken.0: A chicken. Eggs, feathers and strong opinions.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.chicken.1: Chickens can't fly, but they fall gently. Respect.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.chicken.2: Throw an egg and sometimes a chick pops out. Kitchen magic.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.chicken.3: I once saw a baby zombie riding a chicken. I'll never forget it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.chicken.4: That chicken looks at me like I'm a worm with wings.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.chicken.5: Cluck, cluck. That's how every seed tragedy begins.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.horse.0: A horse. Give it apples and patience, and it'll be yours.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.horse.1: They throw you a few times before they love you. Like pixies.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.horse.2: In diamond armor, a horse is almost a dragon. Almost.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.horse.3: It gallops faster than a young dragon. But it can't fly, huh?
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.horse.4: I once won a race riding a horse. He never noticed.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.horse.5: Mane in the wind... I had wings in the wind. Prettier.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wolf.0: A wolf. Give it bones and you'll have a loyal friend to the end.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wolf.1: Wolves chase skeletons. Finally, someone with good taste.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wolf.2: Hit one and the pack comes. Same as pixies.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wolf.3: A wolf with a collar... I had one too. Made of flowers.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wolf.4: They howl at the moon. I sing to it. Each her own style.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wolf.5: Red eyes, bad mood. Don't look, keep walking.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cat.0: A cat. It sleeps on your bed and scares off phantoms.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cat.1: Creepers fear cats. Bring one as a bodyguard.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cat.2: A cat chased me for a century. Well, an afternoon. Felt like a century.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cat.3: Sometimes they bring you gifts when you wake. Cat love.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cat.4: Cats can see pixies. That's why they stare. It scares me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cat.5: It purrs. The only magic I don't have.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.iron_golem: An iron golem. Guards the village better than any king.
It gives poppies to children. Under the iron, a flower's heart.
Attack a villager and it gets angry. And it throws very high.
Made of a pumpkin and iron. My grandma's recipe was similar.
It cracks when hurt. Iron heals it. Wish everything worked that way.
Big, slow and kind-hearted. I like it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.slime.0: A slime. Bouncy, sticky and no manners.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.slime.1: Split it and more come out. Like problems.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.slime.2: Its balls make sticky pistons. Pixie science.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.slime.3: They come out in swamps under a full moon. Very romantic.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.slime.4: I once got stuck to a slime. It was a hard week.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.slime.5: It barely has eyes and still jumps at you. Admirable.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.drowned.0: A drowned. A water zombie with a worse mood.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.drowned.1: If it has a trident, back off. It throws better than you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.drowned.2: They watch you from the deep at night. Creepy.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.drowned.3: Sometimes they carry nautilus shells. And I get no gifts.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.drowned.4: It was a zombie that fell in the water. Bad day for it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.drowned.5: Pixies don't swim. You shouldn't either, with that around.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.phantom.0: A phantom! That's what you get for not sleeping.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.phantom.1: Sleep in a bed and they'll stop coming. Grandma's advice.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.phantom.2: Their membranes mend elytra. Ugly things are useful too.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.phantom.3: They fear cats. Everyone fears cats, have you noticed?
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.phantom.5: A thousand years of little sleep and they never visited me. Pixie perks.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pillager.0: A pillager. A crossbow, a bad face and worse intentions.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pillager.1: See a banner, run. Or get ready for a raid.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pillager.2: They hate villages. And pixies. And everything.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pillager.3: They have outposts. Ugly towers with ugly people.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pillager.4: Some ride dragons in their kingdoms. That's new.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pillager.5: They never smile. Must be the weight of the crossbow.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bee.0: A bee. My distant cousin, more hardworking.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bee.1: Don't hit it: the swarm comes. Hive loyalty.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bee.2: They make honey. I make gossip. We're both sweet.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bee.3: They pollinate and crops grow. Little heroines.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bee.4: If it stings, it loses its stinger. That's commitment.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bee.5: Bzzz. Sounds like an old pixie song.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.fox.0: A fox. Clever, pretty and a thief. Reminds me of someone.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.fox.1: They steal whatever's in your hand. Mind your cakes.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.fox.2: They sleep by day and hunt by night. Pixie hours.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.fox.3: They love sweet berries. So do I. We have a lot in common.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.fox.4: They pounce in the snow like it's magic.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.fox.5: If it trusts you, it'll protect you. Few creatures do.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.rabbit.0: A rabbit. Fast, soft and always in a hurry.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.rabbit.1: Rabbit feet bring luck. Not to the rabbit.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.rabbit.2: They eat the garden carrots. Little thieves.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.rabbit.3: They say there was a killer rabbit. I don't rule it out.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.rabbit.4: A rabbit beat me in a race. Let's not talk about it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.rabbit.5: Hop, hop. I'm tired just watching.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.squid.0: A squid. Ink for writing, and nothing else.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.squid.1: Books are written in its ink. Thank you, squid.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.squid.2: Eight arms and not one hug for me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.squid.4: Scare it and it squirts ink. I squirt gossip.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.squid.5: It lives underwater. Pixies don't understand how.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bat.0: A bat. Sleeps upside down. So do I, after a party.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bat.1: They live in dark caves. No cakes there.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bat.2: Bats and pixies share the night. Badly shared.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bat.3: It does nothing, but it still scares. Talent.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bat.4: Witches use them in potions. Poor things.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bat.5: It squeaks so high my wings hurt.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.llama.0: A llama. If it spits at you, it loves you. A lie.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.llama.1: They carry chests on their backs. Elegant donkeys.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.llama.2: A caravan follows the first llama. Discipline.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.llama.3: Wolves fear them. Llamas fear nothing.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.llama.4: With a carpet on top they look like nobles.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.llama.5: Don't look at me like that, llama. I'm not a fly.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wandering_: A wandering trader. Odd things at odder prices.
His llamas spit. So does he, if you don't buy.
He vanishes at night with a potion. A witch trick.
He sold me a 'magic' seed. It was wheat.
He travels alone with two llamas. Sweet and suspicious.
Never says where he's from. Like pixies.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.allay.0: An allay. It brings you things and sings. My soulmate.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.allay.1: Give it an item and it finds more. Hardworking like no one.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.allay.2: It's blue and flies like me. But it has no thousand years of gossip.
An armadillo. It curls up when scared. I get it.
Its scutes make wolf armor. Generous.
Slow but armored. A turtle with style.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.axolotl.0: An axolotl. Always smiling. I want its secret.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.axolotl.1: They fight beside you underwater. Little pink knights.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.axolotl.2: If it plays dead, relax. It's acting.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.blaze.0: A blaze. Floating fire. My worst nightmare.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.blaze.1: Its rods make potions. Witches adore them.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.blaze.2: Snow puts it out. Throw snowballs at it, really.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bogged.0: A bog skeleton. Poison arrows and bad breath.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bogged.1: Moss and mushrooms on it. Not even bones escape the damp.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bogged.2: Shearing it gives mushrooms. Don't ask how I know.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.breeze.0: A breeze with a temper. It sends your arrows back.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.breeze.1: It jumps and shoots wind. Pixies know all about that.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.breeze.2: Its rods make wind charges. Fun, unless they hit you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.camel.0: A camel. Two riders and zero hurry.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.camel.1: It handles the desert better than me. I dry up.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.camel.2: It sits so you can climb on. Politer than a horse.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.camel_husk: A dried-up camel. It seems to have forgotten it's dead.
Not even the desert spares camels.
Don't ride it. Something tells me it's a bad idea.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cave_spide: A cave spider. Small, venomous and in groups.
Webs in a mine: a spawner is near. Break it.
Milk for the poison. Always carry a bucket.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cod.0: A cod. Swims in schools and thinks of nothing.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cod.1: Good for cats. Don't look at me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.copper_gol: A copper golem. It sorts chests. Wish it sorted my life.
If it oxidizes, it freezes up. Like me without nectar.
Small and helpful. Someone loved it when they made it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.creaking.0: A creaking. It only moves when you don't look. So shy.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.creaking.1: Break its heart tree and it's over. Poor tree.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.creaking.2: Pale forests give me chills. And I'm pale myself.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dolphin.0: A dolphin. It leads you to treasure if you feed it fish.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dolphin.1: Swimming with dolphins makes you faster. And happier.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dolphin.2: They play with whatever floats. Children of the sea.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.donkey.0: A donkey. Carries chests and doesn't complain. Well, it does.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.donkey.1: More stubborn than a pixie on Sunday.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.donkey.2: With a horse it makes mules. Life is strange.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.elder_guar: An elder guardian. It tires you just by looking. Like my grandmothers.
It guards ocean monuments. And sponges.
Milk for the fatigue. And patience.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ender_drag: The Ender Dragon. Not even our dragons mess with it.
Break its crystals first: they heal it.
A dragon without colored scales... how boring.
An endermite. The unwanted child of a pearl.
Endermen hate it. It must have done something.
Small, annoying and purple. Like a bad memory.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.evoker.0: An evoker. Fangs from the ground and vexes from the air. Bad mix.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.evoker.1: It drops a totem of undying. Worth it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.evoker.2: It turns blue sheep red. Not even witches are that odd.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.frog.0: A frog. Eats small slimes and spits out lights.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.frog.1: It croaks in the rain. I sing. We're a duo.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.frog.2: Its color depends on where it was born. Like my paleness.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ghast.0: A ghast. It cries fire. What a sad creature.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ghast.2: Its tears make potions. Even crying is worth something.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.happy_ghas: A happy ghast. I didn't know they existed. A thousand years and still surprised.
It carries people like a kind cloud.
Harness it and you'll fly with me. Company in the sky, at last.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.giant.0: A giant zombie... It shouldn't exist. Don't even ask.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.giant.1: It's so big it can't see me. Advantage.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.giant.2: Some legends are better left asleep.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.glow_squid: A glow squid. Finally someone shinier than me.
Its ink makes signs glow. Underwater fashion.
It lives in the dark and glows anyway. I admire that.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.goat.0: A goat. It rams you without warning. Very honest.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.goat.1: Its horns make music horns. Mountain trumpets.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.goat.2: It leaps cliffs like nothing. I have wings and it's harder for me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.guardian.0: A guardian. A fish with a laser. The sea went mad.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.guardian.1: It circles ocean monuments. Swimming there is a bad idea.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.guardian.2: Its spikes hurt. Attack with a sword, not hugs.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.hoglin.0: A hoglin. A pig with tusks and a temper.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.hoglin.1: It hates warped fungi. Use them as a shield.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.hoglin.2: Outside the Nether it becomes a zoglin. No rest even on holiday.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.husk.0: A desert zombie. Doesn't burn in the sun. How unfair.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.husk.1: Its blow makes you hungry. Like sand.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.husk.2: If it drowns, it becomes a normal zombie. A lucky bath.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.illusioner: An illusioner. It copies itself. Pixies invented that trick.
It blinds you and hides. Such a sore loser.
One is almost never seen. You're unlucky. Or lucky.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.magma_cube: A magma cube. A slime with a fever.
Its cream makes fire potions. Greasy.
It jumps high and burns. Don't hug it.
A mooshroom. A cow with mushrooms. Nature has humor.
With a bowl, mushroom stew. A walking kitchen.
If lightning hits it, it changes color. Electric fashion.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.mule.0: A mule. Half horse, half donkey, all stubbornness.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.mule.2: Stubborn but loyal. I know the type.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.nautilus.0: A nautilus. A pretty shell, a quiet life.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.nautilus.1: It travels the sea as I travel the air.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.nautilus.2: A thousand years and never seen one this close. How lovely.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ocelot.0: An ocelot. Wary and quick. I like it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ocelot.1: Give it fish and maybe it'll trust you. Maybe.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ocelot.2: Creepers fear it. A well-guarded jungle.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.panda.0: A panda. Eats bamboo and sneezes. A whole life.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.panda.1: Some are lazy, some playful. Like pixies.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.panda.2: When a baby panda sneezes, sometimes slime comes out. Don't ask.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.parched.0: A sun-parched skeleton. Even bones get thirsty here.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.parched.1: The desert spares not even the dead.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.parched.2: Dry, crunchy and grumpy. Like old bread.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.parrot.0: A parrot. It imitates monsters. My favorite gossip.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.parrot.1: It dances to music. So do I, secretly.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.parrot.2: Never give it cookies. They hurt it badly.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.piglin.0: A piglin. Loves gold. Wear something golden and you'll be friends.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.piglin.1: It trades gold for odd things. Hellish commerce.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.piglin.2: Outside the Nether it turns zombie. Fresh air disagrees with it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.piglin_bru: A piglin brute. It doesn't bargain. Not even for gold.
It guards bastions like a watchdog with an axe.
Run. There's no shame in running from that.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.polar_bear: A polar bear. If it has cubs, back away.
It fishes on the ice like a king on his throne.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pufferfish: A pufferfish. It puffs up when scared. I get it.
Witches use it to breathe underwater.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ravager.0: A ravager. It charges and wrecks crops. Pure fury.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ravager.1: It comes with raids. Bad news.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ravager.2: Strike when it roars after a stun. A thousand-year tip.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.salmon.0: A salmon. It swims upstream out of pure pride.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.salmon.1: Bears adore it. I'd rather watch it leap.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.salmon.2: Pink like Albia. Know her? Another exiled pixie.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.shulker.0: A shulker. A box that makes you float. The End is weird.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.shulker.1: Its shells make shulker boxes. Magic luggage.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.shulker.2: It hides in its box like I hide under a leaf.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.silverfish: A silverfish. It comes out of stones. Stones can't be trusted.
Hit one and more come out. Curses.
Small, fast and annoying. Like my cousins.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.skeleton_h: A skeleton horse. It comes with storms. And riders.
It swims underwater like a fish. A very odd horse.
Tame it and you'll have the spookiest steed in the realm.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sniffer.0: A sniffer. It sniffs ancient seeds. Older than me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sniffer.1: It came back from the past. Like me, in a way.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sniffer.2: Its seeds give flowers unseen for centuries.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.snow_golem: A snow golem. It throws snow at monsters. Brave and cold.
It melts in the rain. Poor thing.
Without its pumpkin it has a face. Better not look.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.stray.0: A stray. A cold skeleton. Its arrows slow you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.stray.1: Even dead it can't shake the cold. Reminds me of someone.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.stray.2: It lives in the snow. Like a certain queen.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.strider.0: A strider. It walks on lava. Brave or silly.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.strider.1: With a fungus on a stick you ride it. A lava boat.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.strider.2: Out of the lava it shivers. I understand you, friend.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sulfur_cub: A cube that smells of sulfur. Not even pixies go near that.
It bounces like a slime but stinks like a volcano.
Witches would pay for that smell. I wouldn't.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.tadpole.0: A tadpole. Soon a frog. We all grow up.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.tadpole.1: Carry it in a bucket. Little traveler.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.tadpole.2: It swims not knowing where it's going. I get it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.trader_lla: The trader's llama. It spits by contract.
It defends its owner. Loyal and spitty.
Better dressed than me. How envious.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.tropical_f: A tropical fish. Thousands of colors. I lost mine.
Pretty in a tank. Pretty in the sea. Pretty.
Carry them in a bucket: the axolotls will thank you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.turtle.0: A turtle. She returns to her beach to lay eggs. True to home.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.turtle.1: Its scutes make helmets to breathe underwater.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.turtle.2: Don't step on her eggs. Please.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.vex.0: A vex. An evil pixie with a sword. Gives us all a bad name.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.vex.1: It goes through walls. That's cheating. Well, so do I.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.vex.2: Beat the evoker and they fade. Problem solved.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.vindicator: A vindicator. An axe and zero patience.
It lives in woodland mansions. A bad neighbor.
If he's named Johnny, run faster.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.warden.1: It's blind but hears everything. Even my wings.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.warden.2: Not even I go near that, and I've seen dragons.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wither.0: The wither. Three heads and none of them kind.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wither.1: It breaks everything. Fight it far from home.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wither.2: Its nether star is lovely. The rest, not.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.wither_ske: A wither skeleton. Black, tall and sword in hand.
Its bones are what you need for dragonbone weapons.
If it hits you, you wither. Bring milk.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zoglin.0: A zoglin. A hoglin that lost its mind. Literally.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zoglin.1: It attacks everything that moves. Even me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zombie_hor: A zombie horse. Very rare. Today's your day.
Slow, green and loyal. Three odd virtues.
Don't give it carrots. It doesn't enjoy them anymore.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zombie_nau: A zombie nautilus... Even shells rot.
It swims in no hurry at all. Because it has none.
The sea keeps things better left unseen.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zombie_vil: A zombie villager. A golden apple and a weakness potion cure him.
Cure him and he'll give you discounts. Villager gratitude.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.zombified_: A zombified piglin. Calm until you touch it.
Hit one and they all come. Like pixies.
It carries a golden sword and can't use it. What a waste.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.fire_drago: A fire dragon. Smells of summer storms and burnt hair.
Fire dragons live in the heat. Their blood burns, literally.
Its breath melts stone. Imagine what it does to pixies.
Grown females keep red, green and bronze eggs. And don't share.
If its mother roars, it's too late. If the father roars, too.
A fire dragon singed my wing in the sixth century. I still hold a grudge.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ice_dragon: An ice dragon. Reminds me of someone... never mind.
Its breath freezes. Keep away from its mouth, please.
Ice dragons swim under the sea. Elegant and cold.
Their blue and white eggs hatch in water. How romantic.
I don't like the cold. This dragon, even less.
A pixie without wings is a dragon without scales. And this one has plenty.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.lightning_: A lightning dragon. A strange species. All that's missing is poison dragons.
Its breath is lightning. Don't stand near water.
Their eggs hatch when lightning strikes. Very dramatic.
It shines in the storm like I did in my good days.
Smells of metal and rain. Odd, but lovely.
There were no lightning dragons when I was young. Fashions.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.siren.0: A siren. Don't listen. Her song drags you into the sea.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.siren.1: If she charms you, cover your ears. Or hit her. Preferably the first.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.siren.2: They sing beautifully. Pixies sing better and drown no one.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.siren.3: They live on stone islands at sea. Alone. There's a reason.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.siren.4: A siren asked me for a duet. I told her I don't do murderous choirs.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.siren.5: Her scales make armor. But you'll have to dive for them.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cyclops.0: A cyclops. One eye and all the bad temper in the world.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cyclops.1: It tends sheep. Touch one and it chases you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cyclops.2: Its eye is worth a lot. And blind with rage it's dangerous.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cyclops.3: Don't let it grab you. It eats the careless.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cyclops.4: A thousand years ago a cyclops mistook me for a fly. I barely survived.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cyclops.5: Its cave has treasure. And bones. Lots of bones.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.troll.0: A troll. Big, ugly and with a club. Classic.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.troll.1: Trolls turn to stone in the sun. Wait for dawn.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.troll.2: They live in caves and forests. They smell of both.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.troll.3: A troll asked me for a riddle. I gave him one. He's still thinking.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.troll.4: Their tusks are trophies; their clubs, weapons; their breath, punishment.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.troll.5: There are mountain, forest and frost trolls. Equally charming. That is, not at all.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pixie.0: One of mine! She still has all her color.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pixie.1: Young pixies steal things. Not me. Not anymore. Hardly ever.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pixie.2: With a cake she'll be your friend. That's how easy we are.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pixie.3: She's looking at me funny. The color. Or the age.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pixie.4: Put her in a jar and she'll be your lamp. How cruel... and how pretty.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.pixie.5: In my day we were good at everything. Now they specialize. Fashions.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.cockatrice: A cockatrice. A chicken with the evil eye. Literally.
Don't look at it while it looks at you. It weakens you.
Born of a chicken's egg hatched by a snake. What a family.
Tame it and it'll fight for you. With its stare.
Half chicken, half tiny dragon. Witches adore it.
Its eyes make a terrible scepter. Don't tell it I know.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dread.0: The dread undead. They smell of old ice and broken promises.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dread.1: They serve an ice queen. I know her... more than I'd like.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dread.2: They don't sleep, eat, or stop. Worse than villagers.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dread.3: Cold holds them together. Break the magic and they fall apart.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dread.4: Their knights ride bone dragons. Nothing like Black Frost.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dread.5: Each was someone once. How sad ice is.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.hippogryph: A hippogryph. Half eagle, half horse, all pride.
Feed it rabbit and it'll let you ride. Flies better than a horse, of course.
Its feathers shine like mine. Well, like mine used to.
Griffins are proud. Bow a little and maybe they'll respect you.
Their eggs hatch in your hand if you're patient.
I once rode a hippogryph. Well, I sat on a feather. It counts.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.hippocampu: A hippocampus. A sea horse more elegant than any boat.
Give it kelp and it'll let you ride underwater.
It swims like it's dancing. Envy.
A death worm. If the sand trembles, run.
It lives under the desert and comes out when you least expect it.
Its tongue makes a whip. Gross and useful.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.gorgon.0: A gorgon! Don't look her in the eye. Not even sideways.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.gorgon.1: The statues in her temple were adventurers. Like you.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.gorgon.2: Look at her reflection in a shield... or better, don't look.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.stymphalia: Stymphalian birds. Bronze feathers that cut like knives.
They live in flocks in swamps. Bad place for a nap.
Their feathers make fine arrows. Careful picking them up.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.sea_serpen: A sea serpent. If you see it, it already saw you.
Its scales make sea armor. Pretty and wet.
Storms bring it up. Choose well when to sail.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ghost.0: A ghost. It goes through walls. That's cheating.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ghost.1: It only comes out at night in graveyards. Very traditional.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.ghost.2: When a pixie loses her color, she looks a bit like that. How scary.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.hydra.0: A hydra. Cut one head and two grow. Bad math.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.hydra.1: Fire on the wounds: the only thing that stops it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.hydra.2: It lives in poison swamps. A perfect match.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.myrmex.0: Myrmex. Giant ants with a queen and all.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.myrmex.1: If they like you, they trade. If not... run.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.myrmex.2: Their hives are mazes. Take me, I know the way.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.amphithere: An amphithere. A winged jungle serpent. Pretty and fast.
Tame it and you'll fly with it. Finally someone who keeps up with me.
Its feathers are colorful. Like mine... once.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dragon_egg: A dragon egg! Careful with the mother.
Each color hatches differently: fire, water or lightning.
If it hatches beside you, you'll be its family. Forever.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.stone_stat: A statue... it was someone. Gorgons, always the same.
It seems to look at you. It doesn't. I think.
A thousand years and statues still scare me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.dragon_ske: Dragon bones. It died long ago, but still scares.
Right-click it empty-handed and it gives its bones. Generous for a dead thing.
A dragon without scales... now literally.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.sees.bone_drago: A dread bone dragon. Nothing like Black Frost, thank the stars.
It flies with no skin on its wings. Not even I would dare.
Those green eyes... death magic. Stay away.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.sad.0: My friends... they're not here anymore. Let's leave soon, this place makes me sad.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.sad.1: It's normal. A lot of time passed. Pixies don't live a thousand years... almost none.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.sad.2: I used to play here with them. Now only their little houses are left.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.sad.3: Nobody recognizes me. I guess color takes the memories with it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.look.0: The pixies are looking at me funny. Must be the color.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.look.1: I don't like how they look at me. Like I'm a ghost.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.look.2: These young pixies don't know who I am. Just as well.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.look.3: They look and whisper. I whispered too, at their age.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.cake.0: But toss a cake (Q) and any of them will want to be your friend. That easy.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.cake.1: Drop the cake (Q) near one. For a cake they'd sell their own wings.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.friends.cake.2: One cake and you'll have a friend forever. Well, as long as the cake lasts.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.0: Lately they all specialize in one thing. In my day we were good at everything.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.1: In my day level 5 was the basics. Abilities were what mattered.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.2: Magic has changed. Ice and fire are in fashion now.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.3: Lightning dragons, a strange species. All that's missing is poison dragons, what a joke!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.4: A new friend. Don't tell her my age.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.5: Once one pixie was enough for everything. Now you need five. What times.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.6: Orbs? In my day we protected ourselves with pure attitude.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.7: Don't let it go to your head: I'm still your favorite.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.8: Pixie dust to level up... In my day you leveled up with adventures.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.9: Today's pixies shine a lot and know little. You have me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.10: Each color with its gift... Back then we had them all. And a temper too.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.bond.11: Welcome, little one. Any questions, ask grandma. That is, me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.village.o: Did you know there's a village around here? I can smell it: bread, smoke and people saying 'hmm'. Shall we?
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.village.s: This way! On the way I'll tell you about villagers I've known.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.village.d: She takes you to the nearest village there really is. On the way, anecdotes of the villagers she has known.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.village.g: Reach her lantern in the village
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.village.d: A real village! Say hello, they don't bite. Hardly ever.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.cake.here: Here they live. The witches are out... just as well. Their chest is inside.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.horse.off: Can you ride? I used to ride... well, on a horse's mane. Shall we try?
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.horse.sta: Find a horse and get on it. I'll show you one.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.horse.des: Ride a horse (a donkey counts). She'll remember something.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.horse.non: I see no horses near. They graze on plains and savannas.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.horse.don: That's it! I remember... a white horse, and a girl laughing on it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.pixie5.of: Your pixie is still small. If you look after her, maybe she'll remind me of myself.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.pixie5.st: Give your pixie pixie dust in her menu (H) until she reaches level 5.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.pixie5.de: Raise a pixie of yours to level 5 with pixie dust (her menu, H).
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.pixie5.go: A pixie of yours at level 5
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.pixie5.do: That's how I was: whole, all one color. Thank you for reminding me.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.troll.off: There are trolls about. Beating one would bring something back to me... I think.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.troll.sta: Big, ugly and grumpy. Beat one; the sun turns them to stone.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.troll.des: Beat a troll. They come out at night in forests, mountains and snow.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.troll.non: I see no trolls near. They come out at night in forests, mountains and snow.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.troll.don: A troll once blocked our way. She wasn't afraid. I was.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.hippogryp: Shall we fly? A hippogryph would take you higher than my wings.
They trust whoever feeds them rabbit, with patience. Then a saddle, and up!
Win over a hippogryph (rabbit) and ride it with a saddle.
I see no hippogryphs near. They nest high up in the mountains.
We flew like this once, she and I, on a white hippogryph. I'd forgotten.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.hydra.off: A hydra lives in the swamps. If you beat it, I'll remember something important.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.hydra.sta: Let me remember where its cave was...
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.hydra.des: Beat a hydra. Cut its heads and burn what's left, or they grow back.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.hydra.her: It lives in there. Cut its heads and burn the stumps, or they grow back.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.hydra.non: I remember no hydra near. They live in caves in the swamps.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.hydra.don: Many heads... the girl escaped one like that. The ice saved her. That's where it all began.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.quest.ready: I remember everything now. When you find the ice queen, I'll lend you my strength.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.vision.not_read: Wait! You're not ready for this battle yet.
%s of my memories are still missing. Without my gift, her ice goes straight to your heart and you won't heal.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.memories: Her memories back: %s of %s. With all of them, you'll be ready for Cryona.
gui.iceandfire_fabric.exiled.memories_al: All her memories are back (%s of %s): you're ready for Cryona.
iceandfire_fabric.boss.frost_wound: The ice cauterized you! No healing for a while.
iceandfire_fabric.fairy.complete: Your exiled pixie: all her quests done, her bond at level 5. Your %s pixie: bonded at level 5 with all its spells, out with you. Find Cryona: the right moment comes again.
iceandfire_fabric.frost.breath: Black Frost's breath! Out of the red lane.
iceandfire_fabric.cryona.line.anger: Thar'ae... ul sorrah... Thar'ae ul kael!
iceandfire_fabric.cryona.line.fury: KAER! Kaer vael mor... ULMAE, VESSA!
iceandfire_fabric.cryona.mourning_hint: Her grief wakes the dead and calls down the ice. Nothing reaches her: hold on!
iceandfire_fabric.cryona.rays: Rays of ice from the sky: get out of the red circles!
iceandfire_fabric.cryona.beams: Her beams cross the ice: get away from her, between them!
iceandfire_fabric.cryona.ring: A ring of ice: out through a warm light, or jump it!
iceandfire_fabric.frost.pylons: Pylons of ice rose: break them to weaken Black Frost!
iceandfire_fabric.frost.pylon_broken: A pylon falls: Black Frost weakens!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.begin: Watch the ice: it shows every blow first. Let's go!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.breath.0: It's going to breathe! Out of the lane!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.breath.1: Its breath! To the side, quick!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.great_brea: That's its great breath! Get out of the lane!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.dive: It's coming down on you! Out of the circle!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.stampede: A stampede! Off the red lane!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.prison: That blue circle freezes you! Out, now!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.grab: Its claws! Out of the circle!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.pylons: Those pylons of light! Break them, they weaken it.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.zero: Absolute Zero! Run to a warm light!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.falls: It fell... She loved it so. Hold on.
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.dead: The dead wake! Don't let them surround you!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.rays: Rays from the sky! Watch the red circles!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.rises: Now she comes for you. You can do it!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.beams: Beams everywhere! Get away, between them!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.ring: A ring of ice! Out through a light, or jump it!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.hurt: You're badly hurt! Back off and heal!
exiled.iceandfire_fabric.duel.won: You did it! I can't believe it...
death.attack.iceandfire_fabric.frost_bre: %s was frozen by Black Frost's breath
%s became ice in a dragon's breath
%s was swept away by a breath of frost
iceandfire_fabric.cryona.untouchable: Her grief guards her: nothing reaches her now. Hold on!
